page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal instance classified under the Compute Optimized with GPU family. It is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. Memory resources total 512.0 GB of system RAM, providing an even allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by eight discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs, supplying an aggregate total of 192 GB of VRAM across the accelerator array.

Underlying infrastructure management is handled via the KVM hypervisor. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 160 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data ingestion and low-latency network communication across compute nodes. The instance does not include bundled local storage, necessitating the attachment of remote storage volumes for operating system installation and persistent data handling. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are supplied by default.

By packaging eight NVIDIA A10 accelerators alongside 128 dedicated Intel processor cores, this instance delivers dense parallel computing capacity. The configuration is aligned with multi-stream artificial intelligence inference, distributed video transcode pipelines, and high-concurrency visual rendering tasks. The lack of onboard NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, while the high GPU density qualitatively minimizes multi-node networking overhead for accelerator-heavy pipelines.
